qs.q: Which of the following is a contraindication to extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy?
qs.e: ESWL is contraindicated in pregnancy due to fetal radiation exposure. Bleeding disorders are also a concern, but pregnancy is a clear absolute contraindication.
